annotations.title: Search GLEIF Newly Issued LEI Company Formations

description: Stream newly issued global Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs) from GLEIF—new companies, cross-border subsidiaries, funds, and SPVs with incorporation date, legal form, local registry number, and parent links (`corridordata/gleif-new-lei-entity-formations`).

includeParents.description: Resolve direct and ultimate parent LEI/names.

maxItems.description: Maximum newly issued LEI records to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

onlyNewlyIncorporated.description: Only include entities incorporated within 90 days of LEI issuance.

name: search_new_lei_entities
